main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move in the short direction
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: stronger-half minus weaker-half mean unusual move

decided_by: t between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are the bars at positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window with a 5-bar return inside the window and forecast <= -2; the drift is the coin's mean 5-bar return on that grid over all its windows; the stronger half is the cases with forecast at or below the median forecast, the weaker half those above it.
